firewall.description: ufw rulesets keyed by hostname. Order within a host is significant: ufw is first-match and the script applies the list top to bottom.

rule.description: Arguments passed to ufw, verbatim. May contain {lan_cidr}, substituted at render time. Must not be an `insert` -- the ruleset is rebuilt in order, not patched.

comment.description: Passed to ufw as `comment '...'`, so it shows in `ufw status`. Single quotes are not allowed; they would end the shell literal.
